name: gsam-e2e-trial
description: GRE-905: two-week trial of the open-source e2e runner against the release preview (port 3200). Not part of the pnpm workspace.

scripts.list: env -u OPENAI_BASE_URL -u OPENAI_API_KEY E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 e2e list
scripts.login: env -u OPENAI_BASE_URL -u OPENAI_API_KEY E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 e2e login openai
scripts.check: env -u OPENAI_BASE_URL -u OPENAI_API_KEY E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 e2e run --reporter list --reporter json
